extension.summary: View your Immich photos and videos in Kodi
extension.description: Browse the timeline, On this day, people and pets, places, albums and favourites of a self-hosted Immich server, or search by description. Watch them as a slideshow that crossfades and slowly pans and zooms across each photo, with photo details at the press of Info. View only: nothing is changed on the server.
extension.disclaimer: Requires an Immich server that you own or have an account on. Not affiliated with the Immich project.
extension.news: v0.3.7 - Tile names are drawn properly with the Estuary skin's font v0.3.6 - Favourites that showed a tile go back to the Immich icon by themselves, keeping their place v0.3.5 - Tiles stay on the menu: Immich favourites no longer get one, so pick a thumbnail again for any that did - Kodi quits promptly even with a photo or tile request under way v0.3.4 - Kodi no longer waits long on a slow server when it quits while tiles are drawn v0.3.3 - Long tile names wrap onto two lines, so every name stays larger - Tiles redraw straight after an update v0.3.2 - Shuffle everything gets a photo tile too - A soft shadow keeps tile names readable on bright photos v0.3.1 - Photo tiles: the menu and Immich favourites show one of your photos with the folder's name, a new one each day - Rotated phone portraits zoom again on 4K screens v0.3.0 - Pausing eases the photo back to the whole picture and shows it at its sharpest - The caption, clock and Paused have an outline instead of a dark band along the screen edge v0.2.9 - Smooth zoom setting: stops sand, leaves and other fine detail from shimmering, on Kodi builds that support mipmapped textures v0.2.8 - The screensaver moves its date and clock to another corner every five minutes - Fix the screensaver leaving a window behind each time, which could stop slideshows opening v0.2.7 - The screensaver hides the photo count and moves its captions and clock a little, against OLED burn-in
